about: Declared egress catalogue (EP-9 T1). One entry per outbound destination: the process that contacts it, the data classes that leave, the switch that turns it off, and what ZDR does. docs/compliance/evidence/tools/scan-egress.mjs --strict --declared checks it: every scanned vendor needs an entry and every entry needs evidence in the tree. scripts/gates/gen-egress-disclosure.mjs renders the disclosure from this file. This is the engineering reading of the code, for counsel to confirm: region and DPA stay TBC until a contract or a deployment record says otherwise. A ZDR value that cites no test or matrix row says so in its notes with [INF]. Stract, Tantivy and the other in-infrastructure Quarry providers are not declared: no third party receives the query. zdr values: refused (a ZDR run never reaches it); no_retention_attested (a ZDR run may reach it on the recipient's attested no-retention terms); unchanged_no_content (no conversation or document content leaves); not_gated (content can leave on a ZDR run and no gate or attestation was found: an open finding, not a claim).

entries.notes: Downloads feed snapshots for the Quarry URL pre-flight check; the request carries no customer data. The feed URL variables locate the feed and are not switches.

Identity exchange only: no conversation or document content leaves.

Paid provider. Refused on ZDR runs: paid providers are off (model-gateway tool_loop.rs paid_providers_allowed, lines 1724-1730) and Do requests never name a paid provider (EC web_tools.rs, lines 247-253). Cited from the EP-9 design; no matrix row.

Named only in comments of the browser adapter and in an evaluation matrix; no code path calls it. Declared so that the comment evidence is accounted for.

entries.notes: The browser asks Google's favicon service for the hostname of each web result shown, and the omnibox falls back to a Google search for a typed query. The browser sends these, not the platform's model path.

Sends the first five hex characters of the password's SHA-1, with response padding on (k-anonymity). Ungated: runs whenever the check runs.
Model weights are fetched by id at container start into a cache volume. The request carries the model id and the container address; inference runs locally.
Payment orchestration: order and amount data, no conversation content.

Off by default: LETTA_TOOL_SEARCH_ENABLED is false in the compose file. Sends up to 4096 bytes of tool-search query to an operator-supplied endpoint whose host the code does not know. [INF] No ZDR check found in capability-core.

The user's own ChatGPT subscription, under the user's OpenAI terms. A ZDR turn never reaches it (matrix e_zdr_token_never_reaches_subscription; model-gateway normalize.rs SUBSCRIPTION_STRICT_REFUSAL). A waived turn may (matrix e_waiver_subscription_without_connection).

Forwarded mail passes through Postmark before it reaches our webhook. Not wired by any compose file yet. Enabling it for customer organisations needs the sub-processor list, the transfer assessment and the trust page to include it first.

entries.contacting_service: Quarry fetches through an operator proxy
entries.notes: Operator-supplied proxy URIs carry the fetch target to a proxy the code does not name. A configured pool is a third-party processor unless QUARRY_PROXY_FIRST_PARTY is set. Empty means direct egress. [INF] No ZDR check found in quarry-edge.
